qa_pairs.question: What information does the left graph illustrate regarding local disk activity?
qa_pairs.answer: The left graph illustrates the evolution of Input/Output Operations Per Second (IOPS) performed on the local disk over time.

qa_pairs.question: What kind of information does the right graph display concerning local disk usage?
qa_pairs.answer: The right graph shows the evolution of bandwidth utilized on the local disk over time, which represents the quantity of data read or written per second.
